meanings.usage: 指个人亲身经历过的事情，或从实践中获得的知识和技能
指停止工作，结束职业生涯
指多余的或用于替换的
指在记忆中想起过去的事情
指达到预期的目标或目的
指把钱存起来以备将来使用

phrases.usage: 表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，现在已不再继续

examples.en: He used to work in a small shop.
examples.zh: 他过去在一家小商店工作。

examples.en: Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
Frank was telling me about his experiences.
In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
examples.zh: 1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。

examples.en: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
examples.zh: Frank在二十多岁时制造飞机配件。

examples.en: In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory.
examples.zh: 几年之后这个小车间变成了一个大工厂。

examples.en: He remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
examples.zh: 他想起了早年艰难的岁月和通往成功的漫漫长路。

examples.en: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
examples.zh: 她想让他修理他们孙子的自行车！

examples.en: At that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
examples.zh: 在那时他每天工作十四个小时。

grammar.title: used to 的用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + used to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: used to 表示过去经常性的动作或存在的状态，而现在已经不再发生或存在了 用于描述过去的习惯、状态或行为，与现在形成对比

examples.en: He used to work in a small shop.
examples.zh: 他过去在一家小商店工作（现在不在了）。

examples.en: Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
She used to be a teacher.

grammar.title: 一般过去时
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情，常与 yesterday, last week, in 1958 等时间状语连用

examples.en: In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
examples.zh: 1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。

examples.en: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years.
examples.zh: Frank想起早年艰难的岁月时笑了。

grammar.title: when引导的时间状语从句
grammar.structure: 主句 + when + 从句（过去时）
grammar.definition: when引导的时间状语从句表示主句的动作发生在从句动作的过程中 when 从句常用一般过去时，主句可用过去进行时或一般过去时

examples.en: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years.
examples.zh: Frank想起早年艰难的岁月时笑了。

examples.en: He was still smiling when the door opened.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + used to + 动词原形

original.en: He used to work in a small shop.
original.zh: 他过去在一家小商店工作。

imitations.en: She used to live in Beijing.
I used to play tennis when I was young.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + when + 主语 + 动词过去式

original.en: He was still smiling when the door opened.

imitations.en: She was reading when I came in.
They were having dinner when the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 电话响的时候他们正在吃晚饭。

patterns.pattern: In + 年份/时间, 主语 + 动词过去式

original.en: In 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
original.zh: 1958年他买下了自己的一个小车间。

imitations.en: In 2020, she started her own business.
In his thirties, he became a manager.
imitations.zh: 在他三十多岁时，他成为了一名经理。

lines.en: Yesterday afternoon Frank Hawkins was telling me about his experiences as a young man.
lines.zh: 昨天下午弗兰克。霍金斯向我讲述了他年轻时的经历。

lines.en: Before he retired , Frank was the head of a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small shop.
lines.zh: 在退休前，弗兰克是一家非常大的商业公司的经理，但他小时候却在一家小铺里做工。

lines.en: It was his job to repair bicycles and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
lines.zh: 他那时的工作是修理自行车，并且通常是一天工作14个小时。

lines.en: He saved money for years and in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
lines.zh: 他靠多年积蓄，于1958年买下了自己的一个小铺子。

lines.en: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
lines.zh: 20多岁的时候，弗兰克曾生产飞机零配件。

lines.en: At that time he had two helpers.
In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
lines.zh: 几年之后，小铺子已经发展成了一个雇有728人的大工厂。

lines.en: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
lines.zh: 弗兰克回想着他早年的艰难经历和走过的漫长的成功之路，微笑了。

lines.en: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.
lines.zh: 他正笑着的时候门开了，他的妻子走了进来。

lines.en: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
lines.zh: 她叫他去修理孙子的自行车。

questions.zh: 弗兰克的第一份工作是什么？
questions.a: His first job was repairing bicycles in a small shop. As a boy he used to work in a small shop and it was his job to repair bicycles.
questions.aZh: 他的第一份工作是在一家小铺里修理自行车。他小时候在小铺里做工，那时的工作就是修自行车。

questions.q: 按课文顺序梳理弗兰克的经历：从修车少年到728人的大工厂，中间有哪几个关键阶段？
questions.zh: 按课文顺序梳理弗兰克的经历：中间有哪几个关键阶段？
questions.a: As a boy he used to work in a small shop repairing bicycles, fourteen hours a day; he saved money for years and in 1958 bought a small workshop of his own; in his twenties he used to make spare parts for aeroplanes and had only two helpers; in a few years the workshop had become a large factory employing 728 people; before he retired he was the head of a very large business company.
questions.aZh: 小时候在小铺里修自行车（一天十四小时）→多年积蓄，1958年买下自己的小铺子→二十多岁造飞机零件，只有两个帮手→几年后变成雇有728人的大工厂→退休前是一家大公司的负责人。
questions.hint: 抓第 2—9 句的时间标记。

questions.q: 文中的 the head of 和 the long road to success 分别是什么意思？作者为什么把“大公司负责人”和“小铺里做工”放进同一个句子？
questions.zh: the head of 和 the long road to success 是什么意思？作者为什么把两个身份放进同一句？
questions.a: the head of means 'the leader / the boss of'; the long road to success is a metaphor for the long and hard process of becoming successful. The writer puts both in one sentence to contrast his present position with his humble beginnings.
questions.aZh: the head of 意为“……的负责人”；the long road to success 比喻“通往成功的漫漫长路”。同一句里形成今日地位与昔日苦干的对照。
questions.hint: 见第 2 句与第 9 句。

questions.q: 课文中哪些地方用了 used to，哪些用了一般过去时？两者能不能互换？
questions.zh: 课文中哪些地方用了 used to，哪些用了一般过去时？能否互换？
questions.a: used to appears three times: used to work in a small shop, used to work fourteen hours a day, used to make spare parts for aeroplanes — all past habits. Retired, saved, bought, had, employed, smiled, opened, came in and wanted are in the simple past tense. They cannot be swapped: buying the workshop in 1958 was a single finished action, so only bought is correct.
questions.aZh: used to 三处都表过去习惯；retired、saved、bought、had、employed、smiled、opened、came in、wanted 用一般过去时叙述已完成的事。不能互换：1958年买铺子只能写 bought。

questions.q: 故事结尾妻子让弗兰克去修孙子的自行车，这个结尾妙在哪里？
questions.zh: 故事结尾妻子让弗兰克去修孙子的自行车，妙在哪里？
questions.a: It echoes the beginning: Frank started by repairing bicycles and, after a long career as the head of a large company, ends up being asked to repair a bicycle again — this time his grandson's. The circle is humorous and warm, and suggests that success has not changed the man himself.
questions.aZh: 它与开头呼应：弗兰克从修自行车起家，最后又被叫去修孙子的车。这个“回到原点”的循环既幽默又温暖，也暗示成功没有改变他本人。
questions.hint: 把第 3 句与末句对照。

translation:
昨天下午弗兰克。
霍金斯向我讲述了他年轻时的经历。
在退休前，弗兰克是一家非常大的商业公司的经理，但他小时候却在一家小铺里做工。
他那时的工作是修理自行车，并且通常是一天工作14个小时。
他靠多年积蓄，于1958年买下了自己的一个小铺子。
20多岁的时候，弗兰克曾生产飞机零配件。
那时他有两个帮手。
几年之后，小铺子已经发展成了一个雇有728人的大工厂。
弗兰克回想着他早年的艰难经历和走过的漫长的成功之路，微笑了。
他正笑着的时候门开了，他的妻子走了进来。
她叫他去修理孙子的自行车。
title: Success story
subtitle: 成功者的故事

lead.question: 从修车小工到728人工厂老板，弗兰克靠什么走完了那条漫长的成功之路？
lead.warmup: 本课是一篇人物故事：昨天下午，退休的弗兰克·霍金斯向“我”讲起年轻时的经历——小时候在小铺里修自行车，一天干十四小时；二十多岁造飞机零件；1958年用多年积蓄买下自己的小铺子，几年后发展成雇有728人的大工厂。故事结束时，妻子推门进来，要他去修孙子的自行车。阅读时留意三种过去时态的分工。
goals: 掌握 retire、company、workshop、helper、employ、grandson、spare parts 等核心词，以及 the head of、of his own、in his twenties 的用法
区分一般过去时与 used to：一次性过去动作用一般过去时，过去经常的习惯用 used to
理解过去进行时 was telling、was still smiling 在叙事中的背景铺垫作用
能用英语按时间顺序复述弗兰克的经历，并用 used to 讲述自己过去的习惯
lead.summary: 弗兰克退休前是一家大公司的负责人，少年时却在一家小铺里修自行车，一天干十四小时；他多年积蓄，1958年买下自己的小铺子，二十多岁造飞机零件，那时只有两个帮手，几年后工厂已雇了728人。课文用 used to 写过去的习惯，用一般过去时写已经发生的事，用 was telling 作背景，结尾回到修自行车，与开头呼应。
lead.tips: used to 只表“过去经常、现在已不”，1958年买铺子这类一次性动作只能用一般过去时 bought；used to 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的正确形式填空：Before he ______ (retire), Frank was the head of a very large business company.
exercises.note: 过去一次发生的动作用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 按中文提示补全短语：Frank was ______ ______ ______ a very large business company.
汉译英：他二十多岁的时候常常制造飞机零配件。
exercises.a: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
exercises.note: in one's twenties 表二十多岁。

exercises.q: 选词填空：He ______ money for years and in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.（saved / spent / borrowed）
用 job 或 work 填空：It was his ______ to repair bicycles and at that time he used to ______ fourteen hours a day.
exercises.note: job 可数指职位，work 不可数。

exercises.q: 汉译英：几年之后，这个小铺子已经变成了一家雇有728人的大工厂。
exercises.a: In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
exercises.note: employ 雇佣；had become 过去完成。

exercises.q: 改错：He used to buy a small workshop in 1958.
exercises.a: He bought a small workshop in 1958.
exercises.note: 单次过去动作不用 used to。

quiz.q: 弗兰克小时候在那家小铺里做的是哪项工作？
options: Repairing bicycles.
Making spare parts for aeroplanes.
Selling newspapers in the street.
Driving a truck for a factory.
quiz.note: 见 It was his job to repair bicycles。

quiz.q: 课文中 in his twenties 的意思是什么？
options: When he was between 20 and 29 years old.
At the age of exactly twenty.
During the 1920s.
Twenty years ago.

quiz.q: 1958 年弗兰克做了一件什么事？
options: He retired from a large company.
He employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
He bought a small workshop of his own.
He repaired his grandson's bicycle.
quiz.note: of his own 表示“属于自己的”。

quiz.q: “At that time he had two helpers.” 中的 helpers 指的是谁？
options: His two grandsons.
Two people who worked for him in the workshop.
Two large machines in the factory.
The heads of the business company.

quiz.q: “Frank was the head of a very large business company.” 中 the head of 意为？
options: The front page of
The beginning of
The top part of the body of
The leader or boss of

quiz.q: 下列句子中 used to 用法正确的一项是？
options: He used to bought a small workshop in 1958.
He used to work fourteen hours a day.
He is used to work in a small shop.
He used to working in a small shop.
quiz.note: used to 后接动词原形且只表过去。
